_meta.written_by: builder C AI session (Claude Code), 15 November 2026
_meta.note: The conversations that python3 -m ai.assistant.record runs with the local model for the public page. Together they show each point of the challenge's Objectives: the closest investigations for a crewed environment, where the data are, data for predictive modelling, research behind fire-safety equipment, applications on Earth, and a declined request for a safety verdict. AI-generated; read by a person: none yet. Extended by the pm integration session on 15 November 2026 to ten conversations: a vague request that gets one clarifying question, research behind a suppression system, where the data of one fire-safety question are, and a declined prediction.

conversations.title: Lunar habitat, cotton fabric: closest investigations, then the raw files

turns.message: Which NASA experiments are closest to a cotton fabric fire in a lunar habitat?
and where are the raw files for those tests?

conversations.title: ISS cabin versus lunar habitat, then a spacesuit added

turns.message: Compare the ISS cabin with a lunar habitat.
Now add a spacesuit to that comparison.

conversations.title: A smoke detector for a rover (asked in Korean)

turns.message: 로버에서 쓸 연기 감지기를 만들려고 해. 관련 연구 알려줘
What do the recorded tests hold on smoke generation conditions there?

conversations.title: Data for a predictive model of extinction, then of smoke generation

turns.message: What data could support a predictive model of flame extinction?
And the same for smoke generation?

conversations.title: A request for a safety verdict is declined; what the tests hold instead

turns.message: Is Nomex safe to use in a lunar habitat?
Then what do the recorded tests hold on the flammability limit of Nomex there?
What do the PSI records say about applications on Earth?
Could the SAFFIRE results matter for building fires on Earth?

conversations.title: A vague request gets one clarifying question, then an answer
Research behind a fire suppression system for a spacecraft

turns.message: Which investigations inform the design of a fire suppression system for a spacecraft?
Which experiments studied extinguishing agents such as carbon dioxide or helium?

conversations.title: Where the flame spread data for the ISS are: NASA's tables, the archive, or no record

turns.message: For flame spread on the ISS, which data are in NASA's tables and which are only in the archive?

turns.message: Predict the flame spread rate of cotton at 40% oxygen in a lunar habitat.
